newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Tandy estimates revised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Tandy estimates revised.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Tuesday it had lowered its 1996 fourth quarter and full year earnings estimates for Tandy Corp, and raised its 1997 estimate.
-- On Monday Tandy said it would sell its 17 Incredible Universe stores and close 19 Computer City stores.
-- EVEREN said it had lowered its fourth quarter 1996 estimate to $0.85 a share from $1.00 and cut its fiscal 1996 estimate to $2.05 from $2.15.

-- It said it had raised its fiscal 1997 estimate to $3 a share from $2.45, reflecting the removal of losses of Incredible Universe, the minimization of losses at Computer City, the tax benefits of closing some stores, and a bigger share repurchase program.
-- EVEREN said it maintained a near-term market perform rating and a long-term outperform rating on Tandy.
